text: 你头顶的生物是一只真菌状甲壳动物，身长如成人！它的腹面长着数十条蠕动的肢体。
它似乎注意到了你们，转过身来，抓着一个奇怪装置。一片寒意刺向你脚边，草地结霜变白。你们遭到攻击！

en.title: Alone Against the Frost · 631
text: The creature above you is a fungoid crustacean as long as a man! Dozens of writhing limbs perturb its undersurface.
It appears to notice you, and wheels, grasping a strange device. A sheet of cold stabs the ground close to your feet. The grass turns white from frost. You are under attack!
